title: Vedic Saptamsa D7, Dasamsa D10 and Dwadasamsa D12 calculation core

claims.RC-0096: D7 divides each Rashi into seven equal parts; odd signs count from themselves and even signs from the seventh sign.
claims.RC-0097: D10 divides each Rashi into ten 3-degree parts; odd signs count from themselves and even signs from the ninth sign.
claims.RC-0098: D12 divides each Rashi into twelve 2.5-degree parts counted zodiacally from the natal sign itself.

non_claims: No claim is made here for D16+, interpretation, rendered UI, entitlement, independent astronomical golden evidence, device evidence or release readiness.
